newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia and Romania agree to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia and Romania agree to boost trade.

text.p: Visiting Romanian President Emil Constantinescu agreed with Indonesian President Suharto on Friday to work together to boost trade between the two countries.

"Both leaders agreed on the need to exchange visits between officials and the private businessmen from the two countries (to boost trade)," State Secretary Murdiono told reporters after a 90-minute meeting between the two leaders.
Constantinescu, who arrived in Jakarta on Thursday, is scheduled to visit the central Java city of Yogjakarta and the resort island of Bali before returning to Romania on Saturday.
